## Scenarios
Each scenario uses fresh guest context/cart, UK GBP, four 25 kg sacks meeting MOQ; repository default active SKUs assumed, live seed unverified.
1. P1 non-food create/reprice (AC1-AC3), risk wrong price/safety: (1) Navigate category to Custom Blend without login. Select Laundry Detergent HCL-0020-001 base, All-Purpose Cleaner HCL-0022-001 ingredient, set75/25. (2) Assert materials GBP405.60, fee25.00, total430.60. Set60/40; assert materials391.20,total416.20, fee still25.00, both updates in place without reload. (3) Assert non-food label and readable handling guidance in summary, even if current product omits it. (4) Add; assert exactly one blend line, Laundry/Cleaner60/40,total416.20 matching summary. Assert continue-shopping and checkout options available; checkout destination /checkout, do not complete checkout.
2. P1 evaluated rejection/recovery (AC4), risk invalid cart/lost draft: (1) Cleaner base with Titanium TCM-0036-001 6% and Iron Oxide Red TCM-0037-001 5%; evaluate. (2) Assert visible pigment-cap reason, disabled Add, unchanged empty cart, preserved selected draft. (3) Change Titanium to5%, leave red5%; assert cleared error, add corrected90/5/5 successfully.
3. P1 edit (AC5), risk duplicate/wrong line: Independent saved valid Laundry/Cleaner75/25 line at quantity4. (1) Edit; assert original base, ingredient, proportions restored. (2) Set60/40,save. (3) Assert same line replaced, no duplicate, changed composition60/40 and price416.20.
4. P2 food (AC3), risk hard-coded label: (1) Configure Flour BKP-0001-001/Cornstarch BKP-0006-00195/5. (2) Evaluate; assert food classification in summary.
## Existing coverage
e2e/catalog.spec.ts covers search; customBlendRules.test.ts covers rule/pricing matrix; CustomBlendPage.test.tsx covers mocked UI; cart integration tests cover create/replace. These browser journeys cover real guest/cart wiring; avoid exhaustive matrix.
## Risks
customBlendRules.ts:42 compatibility, contracts/customBlends.ts:18,24 bounds/cap, customBlendState.ts:117 clamp. Current BlendSummaryAside.tsx guidance may be absent despite AC3; test asserts required readable summary guidance. Active default fixtures assumed; no browser observations claimed.
## Approach
Source oracle: model.ts:243 sack multiplier12; householdCleaning.ts:41 Laundry895*12=10740p and :126 Cleaner695*12=8340p. ((10740*.75)+(8340*.25))*4+2500=43060p; ((10740*.60)+(8340*.40))*4+2500=41620p. Fee from pricing.ts:8 once. Each scenario independent guest/cart. Trace unavailable; process and efficiency unknown.
